li.label: afraid of them now
li.description: I know what those hands have done. I keep the table between us, and I always know where the door is.

li.label: fascinated by their past
li.description: Finally, somebody interesting around here. I have so many questions, and I suspect they have answers.

li.label: they put lives at risk
li.description: They knew what they were carrying, and they got on that shuttle anyway. People died of it. What would they do if it happened here?

li.label: a real star
li.description: I know that song. Everybody knows that song. And all this time they've been mending fences with the rest of us.

li.label: touched by their secret
li.description: Of all the things to be hiding. I didn't know they had that in them, and now I can't stop thinking about it.

li.label: wasteful
li.description: Out here every scrap and every patch of good soil is earned, and they've been spending ours on nothing.

li.label: took credit for someone else's work
li.description: All those compliments at dinner, and not once did they say who really made it.

li.label: heard their story
li.description: They stood at the fire and told us all of it, the worst parts too. It's hard to stay angry at someone who does that.

li.label: an old wound opened
li.description: I'd almost stopped thinking about it. Now everyone knows, everyone is kind about it, and I can't stop thinking about it again.

li.label: they'll come for me now
li.description: Word travels. If they know here, the people who are looking for me will know soon enough.

li.label: no more pretending
li.description: They know I'm sick. I don't have to smile through the bad days anymore. I didn't know how tired I was of smiling.

li.label: watched like a criminal
li.description: Someone is always nearby. Someone is always looking. I served my sentence in my own head for years; now I serve it here too.

li.label: the colony heard me out
li.description: I told them all of it, at the fire. Nobody got up and left. I didn't know how much I needed that.

li.label: grilled at the fire
li.description: They asked me to tell my side, then asked the same questions over and over until my side sounded worse than theirs.

li.label: the council sold me out
li.description: They took silver for telling the hunters where I sleep. I sleep with a knife now, and I don't sleep much.

li.label: the council protected me
li.description: They had a sack of silver on offer, and they chose me instead. I won't forget it.

li.label: blood money in the stores
li.description: We sold one of our own for a sack of silver. I can't look at the stockpile the same way.

li.label: the council turned down good silver
li.description: A sack of silver, offered for nothing but a name and a closed gate, and the council said no.

li.label: doctoring under supervision
li.description: Every stitch I make, someone checks it. I suppose I've earned that. It still stings.

li.label: barred from doctoring
li.description: They took my instruments away. Maybe they're right to. I was good at this once.

li.label: told to hold my tongue
li.description: I only said what everyone was thinking. Apparently that's not allowed anymore.

li.label: the colony paid my debt
li.description: Years of looking over my shoulder, settled with silver that wasn't mine. I'll make it right. Somehow.

li.label: left alone with my debt
li.description: They know who I owe and what those people do. They said it's my problem. I suppose it is.

li.label: honored at supper
li.description: They raised their cups to me at supper. I wanted the floor to swallow me. I'm still smiling about it.

li.label: a quiet thank-you
li.description: A few words in private from the council, and nothing more. That was exactly the right size.

li.label: someone else's toast
li.description: The whole colony raising cups to one person for a few kind deeds. I do kind deeds. Nobody raises anything to me.

li.label: quarantined
li.description: A room to myself, food left at the door, and everyone I care about talking to me through it.

li.label: the council took precautions
li.description: Something dangerous was right here among us, and the council actually did something about it. I'll sleep better.

li.label: made to fight for a crowd again
li.description: I left the pits behind. Then the pits followed me here, with a crowd and a betting pool and everything.

li.label: kept out of the pit
li.description: They wanted a show. The council said no. I'm not that person anymore, and somebody here believes it.

li.label: getting clean, with help
li.description: A week off, someone beside me, and nobody pretending it's easy. I might actually manage it this time.

li.label: sat up with someone through the worst
li.description: Long nights, bad nights and a lot of bargaining. They're still clean this morning. I could sleep for a week.

li.label: my room was searched
li.description: They went through everything I own and burned what they found. There's nothing left to hide behind, and nobody to ask for help.

li.label: they let it lie
li.description: The council told everyone to drop it. Mostly, they have. I can eat my dinner again.

li.label: not allowed to talk about it
li.description: The council has ruled that we don't talk about it. So of course it's all anyone thinks about.

li.label: my secret, my say
li.description: The council let me decide what happens with it now. After everything, that's more than I expected.
